stem: What does the speaker’s sister do when she learns about the Styrofoam wings?

options.label: A
options.text: She tells the speaker that she thinks the wings are cute.

options.label: B
options.text: She asks the speaker to bring her something from the flight.

options.label: C
options.text: She wonders if the wings will really work.

options.label: D
options.text: She asks the speaker to make her some wings too.
